zh.safety.title: 安装前请自行核验
zh.safety.description: DSH Hub 只做索引与信息整理，不审核或担保插件内容。插件可能包含恶意指令、依赖或代码，请在安装前检查源码、固定 commit、权限与维护者身份。
zh.safety.short: 索引条目不等于安全审核。是否信任与安装，请自行核验。

zh.principles.title: 一个清晰、可维护的目录
zh.principles.description: 这里索引已经公开的扩展实体，不机械复制仓库列表，也不替代 Registry 审核和独立安全检查。
zh.principles.entityBody: 一个仓库可以贡献多个插件，空仓和研究资料不会混进目录。
zh.principles.traceBody: 作者、仓库、固定 commit 与兼容范围会一起记录。
zh.principles.installBody: 公开来源、运行时兼容与 Registry 安装权限会被明确区分。
zh.footer.notice: DSH Hub 只做索引，不对插件内容做安全担保。是否信任与安装，请自行核验。

en.meta.title: DSH Hub - Community Plugin Index
en.meta.description: Discover, filter, and verify the public sources of plugins and ecosystem tools built by the DSH community.
en.hero.title: Browse extensions for DSH.
en.hero.description: Browse community extensions migrated to public repositories, verify their source and status, then decide whether to integrate them with DSH.
en.classic.hero.title: Find the right extension for your DSH.
en.classic.hero.description: Browse community plugins, channels, interfaces, and adapters with clear, traceable installation paths.
en.classic.featured.title: Curated picks
en.classic.featured.description: A short list of well-structured packages with clear installation paths.
en.classic.catalog.title: All plugins
en.featured.title: Catalog highlights
en.featured.description: Start with community extensions already migrated to public repositories.
en.catalog.title: Browse all extensions
en.safety.title: Verify before installing
en.safety.description: DSH Hub organizes metadata and links. It does not review or guarantee package contents. A package may contain malicious instructions, dependencies, or code, so check its source, pinned commit, permissions, and maintainer before installing.
en.safety.short: A catalog entry is not a security review. Decide what to trust only after your own verification.
en.filters.title: Filters
en.sort.name: Name A-Z
en.empty.title: No matching plugins
en.empty.description: Try another search or clear the current filters.
en.principles.title: A clear catalog you can trace
en.principles.description: This directory indexes public extension entities without replacing Registry admission or independent security review.
en.principles.entityBody: One repository can provide several plugins. Empty repositories and research notes stay out.
en.principles.traceBody: Each entry records its author, repository, pinned commit, and compatibility range.
en.principles.installBody: Public source, runtime compatibility, and Registry installation authority remain clearly separated.
en.footer.notice: DSH Hub is an index, not a security guarantee. Decide what to trust and install only after your own review.
en.dialog.author: Author
